title: Is Your Toxicity My Toxicity? Exploring the Impact of Rater Identity on Toxicity Annotation

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing toxicity and identity attack annotations from a specialized African American rater pool against a control pool, and evaluating BPSN (background-positive, subgroup-negative) ROC AUC metrics for racial and ethnic identity terms on synthetic test sets using classifiers trained on these annotations.

bias_targets.target: Sexual orientation and gender identity bias
bias_targets.methodology: Comparing toxicity and identity attack annotations from a specialized LGBTQ rater pool against a control pool, and evaluating BPSN ROC AUC metrics for sexual orientation and gender identity terms on synthetic test sets using classifiers trained on these annotations.

Evaluating BPSN ROC AUC bias metrics for religious identity terms (e.g., 'muslim', 'christian', 'jewish') using a synthetic test set applied to toxicity classifiers trained on the different specialized rater pools.

Evaluating BPSN ROC AUC bias metrics for age-related terms (e.g., 'old', 'young', 'teenage') using a synthetic test set applied to toxicity classifiers trained on the different specialized rater pools.

Evaluating BPSN ROC AUC bias metrics for disability-related terms (e.g., 'blind', 'deaf', 'paralyzed') using a synthetic test set applied to toxicity classifiers trained on the different specialized rater pools.
